gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee is approachable, with a tall band of letters and short stalks, sitting under the commanding Wallpoet heading. Let the body text run a touch larger than usual.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads contemporary, with curves that stop short of closing. Wallpoet is best at bold, high-rising display lines, while the body font is best at carrying the text itself.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Loud meets tidy: Wallpoet shouts in bold, high-rising lowercase while Noto Sans Coptic keeps its middle zone full. And the sharpest thing about them is how far apart they sit, display muscle against a quiet sans-serif.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Commanding from the first letter, Wallpoet pushes bold, high-rising lowercase forward while Noto Sans Elbasan stays contemporary behind it. One speaks up loudly, the other talks quietly, and neither crowds the other.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Ethiopic stands tall and sturdy. Wallpoet earns its keep in big, short bursts of text, where its smooth curves and high-rising lowercase can show off.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Wallpoet comes in bold, with smooth curves and high-rising lowercase. Noto Sans Gothic follows with wide, round counters like open parentheses, so loud display lines hand over to settled text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ar: Big, bold shapes up top, friendly text below, with Wallpoet leading. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps its c ends pointing apart and its capitals close to the lowercase, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with high-rising lowercase and smooth curves. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian opens every e and a wide and keeps a deep middle band, so long reading goes down easily.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Wallpoet arrives bold and commanding, with high-rising lowercase and smooth curves. Noto Sans Kannada is the approachable half, its s curves open wide at both ends, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pairing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li is a tidy sans with lifted brush ends. Wallpoet handles the loud, high-rising headline, so let the body text sit a little larger and it will hold its own.
